subject.title: fix(feishu): re-throw unresolved SecretRef errors from media fallbacks

question: Should the canonical fix pass the active resolved runtime snapshot into all affected Feishu delivery paths, or intentionally adopt per-send Feishu credential resolution instead?
rationale: The current PR only changes failure behavior, while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89403 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89454 propose different credential ownership boundaries; repository policy favors active-snapshot runtime reads, but maintainers must select the permanent Feishu handoff design.

options.title: Use Active Runtime Snapshot
options.body: Repair the Gateway/channel handoff so every affected Feishu delivery path receives already-resolved credentials and retains transient media fallbacks.

options.title: Resolve At Feishu Send Boundary
options.body: Refresh and evaluate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89454 as an intentional exception that performs scoped async credential resolution in Feishu delivery code.

options.title: Accept Fail-Loud Only
options.body: Land this narrow patch knowing SecretRef-backed media still does not deliver and existing fallback behavior becomes a hard failure.

recommendation.title: Use Active Runtime Snapshot
recommendation.body: Repair the Gateway/channel handoff so every affected Feishu delivery path receives already-resolved credentials and retains transient media fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects this person to both the strict Feishu credential resolver and adjacent media/reply architecture.
